Container.Name: OnceBudget
Container.Overview: Sync server for the Once Budget app (envelope budgeting) by RightToOwn LLC. Your data stays on your server: no accounts, no tracking. Open the web UI once to create a password, then pair phones by scanning a QR code.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port for the web app and the phones

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Your budget and 14 days of nightly backups

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: For the 3 a.m. backup and morning reminders

Config.Name: Sign-in
Config.Description: password: create one on first visit, pair phones by QR, add other people (recommended; add CF_ACCESS_TEAM and CF_ACCESS_AUD variables to also accept Cloudflare sign-ins). cloudflare: Cloudflare Access in front, each person by email. Both keep each person's budgets private. open: no login and no separation (home network only).

Config.Name: User ID
Config.Description: The user that owns your data folder (99 = Unraid's nobody)

Config.Name: Group ID
Config.Description: The group that owns your data folder (100 = Unraid's users)

Config.Name: Backup days
Config.Description: How many days of nightly backups to keep
